messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week treated you alright. Go ahead and take your blood pressure when you're ready and send me the numbers.
It's not working. Screen just says ERR every single time I try. Tried like four times.

That's annoying, I'm sorry. Device troubleshooting is something I'm not set up to help with — you'd need to contact the cuff's manufacturer or whoever supplied it to you. I can't escalate that to our nurses either, since it's a device issue rather than a health one. While you've got me — are you taking your blood pressure medications as prescribed?
Yeah taking everything same as always. Just been a while since I could get a real reading, starting to wonder.

Good to hear the medications are on track — I've noted that. The wondering makes sense. Once you've got a working cuff, text the reading in anytime and I'll log it. I'll schedule your next regular check-in for seven days from today.

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
